headline: HUMANOID ROBOTS GO PUBLIC
subhead: Unitree prices its Shanghai IPO at ~$9B; DeepSeek joins the cap table.
poster_story: Unitree priced its Shanghai STAR Market IPO at 150.80 yuan per share, valuing the company at about 61 billion yuan (~$9.04B) and raising about 6.1 billion yuan (~$904M) by selling 40.45 million new shares, 10% of enlarged capital; DeepSeek took 933,399 shares (2.31% of the strategic placement) for 140.8 million yuan (~$20.8M) alongside a joint model-development pact. It is the first publicly traded humanoid robot maker.
